title: P-40 portable pure-water cart: hose-fed RO and DI | Aquemi
meta: The Aquemi P-40 is a portable RO/DI cart: sediment, catalytic carbon, one 4040 RO element and mixed-bed DI on a wheeled aluminium frame. Tap pressure does the work.
headline: Low-mineral water, made where the job is
lead: Reverse osmosis and deionization on one hose-fed cart. Connect a garden hose, open the tap and take low-mineral water from the outlet hose. No pump, tank or power supply: tap pressure does the work.

blocks.intro: Water passes the four stages in a fixed order. Three 3/4 in garden-hose connections: feed, product and concentrate.

stages.label: In
stages.d: A hose tap on a mains supply at 2.8 to 5.5 bar (40 to 80 psi); a pressure regulator above that.
5 µm, in a 10 × 2.5 in housing. Changed on pressure drop.
10 × 4.5 in housing. Removes chlorine and chloramine, which would damage the membrane.
One 4040 element in a 304 stainless steel housing. Concentrate leaves through a fixed 1.6 mm orifice, always open, with a ball valve to set recovery and flush.
10 × 4.5 in housing. Design target: 0 ppm TDS reading at the outlet while the resin has capacity.

stages.label: Out
stages.d: Low-mineral water, checked with a handheld TDS meter.

blocks.h: Where it fits, and where it does not

items.t: Vehicle, fleet and boat final rinse
items.d: Spot-free rinse at the yard or the dock, and solar panel washing.
Battery and coolant top-up, closed heating and chilled-water loop fill, pressure-washer and steam-cleaner feed.
Drinking water. Laboratory water grades. Dental units, autoclaves and sterilizers. Dialysis and pharmaceutical Purified Water. Continuous production duty.

items.a: No. The P-40 is not designed or certified for drinking water. For drinking water from air, see the AeroWell.

items.q: What do I need on site?
items.a: A hose tap at 2.8 to 5.5 bar (a regulator above that), three garden hoses, a drain for the concentrate hose and a handheld TDS meter to check the outlet.

items.q: How do I know the resin is spent?
items.a: The outlet TDS reading rises above 0 ppm. Change the DI cartridge. The carbon block and sediment filter have their own intervals.
The first units are built to order with a longer lead time while we complete the design and test the first unit. Price and lead time: confirmed when you enquire.
